| date = {{start date|1992|5|15}}

The '''1992 Taoyuan County tour bus fire''' was a 1992 fire in a bus full of kindergarteners in [[Taoyuan, Taiwan]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Bus catches fire, kindergarten students die - UPI Archives |url=https://www.upi.com/Archives/1992/05/15/Bus-catches-fire-kindergarten-students-die/5514705902400/ |access-date=2023-04-22 |website=UPI |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" /><ref name=":4" /> 23 people died in the fire.<ref name=":0">{{cite news |date=15 May 2007 |title=健康幼稚園意外15年 倖存學生現身 |language=zh |publisher=TVBS |url=https://news.tvbs.com.tw/life/324675 |access-date=27 May 2020}}</ref>

Lin Ching-chuan, a teacher who died trying to save children was the first civilian honored at the [[National Revolutionary Martyrs' Shrine]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Han Cheung |date=28 August 2022 |title=Taiwan in Time: Civilians enter the Martyrs' Shrine |work=Taipei Times |url=https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/feat/archives/2022/08/28/2003784279 |access-date=28 August 2022}}</ref>

[[Hou Yu-ih]]'s firstborn son Hou Ni-wei died in the fire.<ref name=":2">{{cite news |date=29 August 2015 |title=侯友宜喪子痛 |language=zh |publisher=Chinese Television System |url=https://news.cts.com.tw/cts/general/201508/201508291654672.html |access-date=27 May 2020}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{cite news |date=31 May 2018 |title=侯友宜悼亡兒 哽咽「一生至痛」 |language=zh |work=Apple Daily |url=https://tw.appledaily.com/headline/20180531/APMNL5KTD7SKYVBOWWPN2BE3UQ/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=27 May 2020}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{cite news |date=20 July 2016 |title=回顧：24年前幼稚園火燒車意外 她衝入火海... |language=zh |work=China Times |url=https://www.chinatimes.com/hottopic/20160720002442-260803 |access-date=27 May 2020}}</ref>
